correctness.rationale: The normalized conformal derivative is bounded by a family of first-Fourier Poisson boundary pairings. The support function of the ellipse gives J(u); strict convexity and endpoint signs give a unique interior minimizer. The maximizing boundary trace yields a centered conformal jet with the exact value, a convex-target harmonic diffeomorphism by Radó–Kneser–Choquet, and unique equality by strict support points. The quantitative deficit is the elementary Hilbert-ball identity with the uniform positive norm min(au,b(1-u)); shape limits follow from integral bounds and analytic perturbation. The standalone script numerically checks but does not prove the universal assertions.
